units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:2">B. Bath. IX, 2</cite> <he>אם אין שם י׳ וכ׳</he> if there is no other heir besides.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 139a:14">Ib. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>שויוה רבנן כי׳ … כלוקח</he> the Rabbis gave him the privileges of an heir (to his wife’s property) and those of a purchaser; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>יוֹרְשִׁים</he>, <he>יוֹרְשִׁין</he>.
Ib. IX, 9 יוֹרְשֵׁי האשה וכ׳ the wife’s heirs-at-law claim that the husband died first; a. v. fr.—Fem. יוֹרֶשֶׁת, pl. יוֹרְשׁוֹת.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 119a">Ib. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>יודע</he> … <he>י׳ הן</he> Moses knew that the daughters of Z. were legal heirs.
